Results.ReviewText:
I love my Weber grill. It is the most consistent, best built grill that I have ever owned, and it it the right size for my family of four. I love how the temp is balanced front to back. My previous grills would always have "hot spots" and larger items needed turning in order to balance the cooking. I also love how the burner knobs actually adjust my grill's temp. Previous grills that I owned adjusted the flame but never really adjusted the temps. I also bought the griddle plate and have used it for making sandwiches and searing breakfast steaks.

One thing I especially like is how easy it is to get Weber parts and accessories at my local store. Previous grills, if parts were even available, required extensive research and a mail order. I don't anticipating needing new parts for a while, but it's reassuring to know they are locally available and in stock! It's also great to see all the accessories, and to make my wish list.
Results.Title: Love my new Weber Spirit II grill!

Results.ReviewText: The grill holds up well, except for parts that will rust out and eventually be replaced.  For example, the 3 V-shaped "flavor" pieces will turn to rust in a couple of years.  AND.....the cheap horrible wheels are made of plastic and will start to fall apart, also requiring replacement.  Replacement wheels from Weber are a complete ripoff.  Your best bet are the 3" clear neoprene wheels you can get at Harbor Freight. $4 to $5 compared to the price of Weber wheels. Harbor Freight wheels line up perfectly for this grill.

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.
